claim: Opus One (Oakville) offers tiered appointment-only experiences: $150 Estate Tasting (rooftop terrace, two vintages + Overture), $250 Opus One Experience (Partners' Room, library wines + tour), and $793 Art of the Table four-course pairing.
quote: Opus One Experience Price: $250 per person ... Opus One Estate Tasting Price: $150 per person ... Art of the Table Price: $793 per person ... minimum of four guests

claim: Domaine Carneros (Carneros) is a French-style chateau specializing in methode traditionnelle sparkling and estate Pinot Noir, with seated terrace tastings overlooking Carneros hills and caviar/charcuterie pairings, by reservation daily.
quote: Reservations are required and are available daily beginning at 10:00am with the last reservation at 5:00pm.

claim: Castello di Amorosa (Calistoga, north of St. Helena) is an authentically-styled 14th-century Tuscan castle winery open by reservation only, offering tours, tastings and food-and-wine pairings daily 10am-5:30pm.
quote: Open by Reservation Only ... Daily: 10:00am-5:30pm ... authentically-styled 14th century Tuscan castle winery

claim: Castello di Amorosa, built by Dario Sattui and opened 2007, has 107 rooms over 8 levels (~141,000 sq ft after expansion) including a moat, drawbridge, defensive towers, courtyard, torture chamber, chapel and a great hall.
quote: 107 rooms on 8 levels above and below ground ... includes a moat, a drawbridge, defensive towers, an interior courtyard, a torture chamber, a chapel/church, a knights' chamber

claim: Quintessa (Rutherford/St. Helena) is a 280-acre organic and Biodynamic estate offering a ~$175 Communal Estate Experience and a ~$300 Quintessential Experience in a private open-air pavilion with library vintages and barrel samples, by reservation.
quote: Communal Estate Experience ... $175 per guest ... Quintessential Experience ... $300 per guest ... private, open-air pavilion surrounded by rolling vineyards ... organically and Biodynamic

claim: HALL St. Helena offers appointment tastings ranging from a $60 Flight Tasting and $75 Tour & Tasting to a $150 Cabernet Experience and $200 Platinum Tasting (max four guests).
quote: Platinum Tasting: $200 per guest ... Cabernet Experience ... $150 per person ... Flight Tasting ... $60 per person ... Tour & Tasting ... $75 per person

claim: HALL Rutherford, set amid the Sacrashe vineyard a few minutes from the St. Helena winery, offers a wine-and-food experience in its dramatic underground wine cave paired with top-tier wines.
quote: HALL Rutherford Wine Cave, with savory creations thoughtfully paired with their top tier wines

claim: Artesa Winery (Carneros) is a striking modern hilltop estate (2018 AIA Design Award) with panoramic views, sculptures and fountains, offering a $65 Terrace Seating five-wine tasting and a $105 guided tour with five wines, by reservation.
quote: guided tour includes a tasting of five wines for $105 per person ... Terrace Seating includes a tasting of five exclusive wines for $65 ... 2018 Design Award from the American Institute of Architects

claim: Domaine Chandon in Yountville itself offers sparkling wine tastings from roughly $36, plus private Garden Cabanas with Brut Rose and communal local dishes, with reservations 10am-4pm and walk-ins welcome subject to availability.
quote: Tastings and experiences are available from 10 AM - 4 PM by reservation, with walk-ins welcome based on availability ... Garden Cabanas are available as private spaces

claim: Robert Mondavi Winery (Oakville) reopens April 20, 2026 after multi-year renovation, offering the $95 Mondavi Table three-course pairing, $180 Pioneer Tasting, and a To Kalon Legend Tasting & Tour, by appointment.
quote: reopen to guests on April 20th, 2026 ... Pioneer Tasting ... $180 ... The Mondavi Table ... $95 ... The Legend Tasting & Tour ... To Kalon Reserve wines

claim: Across Napa Valley in 2026, standard tastings average $50-75 per person while premium/reserve experiences run $85-125+, and nearly all wineries require reservations 2-4 weeks ahead with many waiving fees on minimum wine purchases.
quote: Standard tastings in Napa Valley average $50-75 per person in 2026, while premium and reserve experiences run $85-125+ ... Nearly all Napa wineries require reservations
